author: Arachadonic
body:
Okay so as it stands the spawn of the Map flare looks like this:

However other players and I feel that the distance from the spawn to the mainland center platform is too long. For most of this map we seem to be just walking instead of fighting. So my suggestion is either bring the spawn right up to the mainland circle OR maybe in the middle of the bridge thing. 

Share your opinions below!
